name: @limio/ot-onboarding-chat
description: OpenText order-confirmation: opens the Limio chat embed (window.LimioChat) and sends the onboarding agent a first message with the order reference and email of the order just placed, so the agent can look the order up through the Limio API connector. Renders nothing; sends once per order.

limioProps.label: Open the assistant automatically when the page loads
If not opened automatically, send the order details the first time the visitor opens the chat
First message ({orderReference}, {email})
limioProps.default: Hi, I've just placed order {orderReference} with {email}. Let's set up my onboarding.

limioProps.label: First message when there is no order reference ({email})
limioProps.default: Hi, I've just placed an order with {email}. Let's set up my onboarding.
